workstreams.name: Claims and underwriting
workstreams.answers: How do claims and underwriting organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in each unit
Walk through each unit's processes with its staff
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Sales and customer service
workstreams.answers: How do sales and customer service organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview staff and walk through each unit's processes
Gather customer input on sales and service contacts
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Finance
workstreams.answers: How does finance organize its work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in finance
Review finance process documents and cost records
Measure workload and cost from operational data

workstreams.name: Gaps and priority areas
workstreams.answers: Where do cost, workload and performance gaps across the five units matter most for the new model?
activities: Compare cost, workload and performance across the units
Rank the gaps by how much they matter for the new model
Test the ranking with unit heads and their teams

workstreams.name: Target operating model
workstreams.answers: Which target operating model for the five units can the executive committee approve?
activities: Draft model options for structure, roles and governance
Test the options against the diagnostic findings
Prepare the options for the design workshop

workstreams.name: Unit-level design
workstreams.answers: How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance with unit leaders
Run unit design rounds, two units at a time
Check each unit design with the people who do the work

workstreams.name: Transition plan by unit
workstreams.answers: What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?
activities: Sequence each unit's move from today's model to the target
Plan each unit's change two at a time with its leaders
Align the unit plans on timing and dependencies

workstreams.name: Executive committee sign-off
workstreams.answers: What do the executive committee and unit heads need to see to approve the model and transition plans?
activities: Review the model and plans with the executive committee
Collect comments from unit heads and resolve them
Finalize the model and plans for the final readout
